name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx multi-site web serving for three virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, hardened settings, firewall rules, fail2ban, sysctl configuration, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, logging, and cleanup of generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python prerequisites, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
